about.title: About Pool Tech
text: We are a family-owned pool maintenance, leak detection, equipment repair, and pool equipment installation company. Our focus is relationship-first service that helps you make informed decisions about your pool.
Honesty and integrity guide every job. We explain what we find and help you choose what makes sense for your pool and your budget.
Our work is backed by a one-year workmanship warranty plus applicable manufacturer warranties.
